name: La Diablesse
description: La Diablesse ('the She-Devil') is a Caribbean folkloric demoness, especially associated with Trinidad and Tobago, who appears as a beautiful woman in old-fashioned dress with one human leg and one cloven cow-hoof, luring men into the forest where they become lost and die.

aliases.name: She-Devil
aliases.meaning: literal English gloss of la diablesse

origin: Trinidad and Tobago is the heartland of the La Diablesse tradition, with cognate figures in Grenada, Saint Lucia, Dominica and other French-Creole Caribbean islands.
